request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2, including maintenance and enhancement plus Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node in Rust that provides efficient access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos is said to expose five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros Node-to-Client Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The document reports Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope covers dependency updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, external contribution review, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, public communication, and AI-friendly resources.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposer states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission time, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states audit and oversight costs are included in overhead, with Intersect and technically capable third parties providing reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

The document states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and that 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

The proposal identifies Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, specific reserve and project payment addresses, oversight committee entities, authorization thresholds, and a dashboard for community audit and on-chain verification.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance continuation administered by Intersect, citing open-source infrastructure value, prior budget-process support, NCL compliance, oversight controls, and checkable smart-contract infrastructure, while the deterministic assessment notes missing alternatives and failure-mode analyses.
